name: pii-filter
description:
Spec-054 FR-012/FR-013/FR-014 — HMAC PII filter conformance vector.

Given the PII input fields below and the deterministic stub HMAC key listed in `stub_hmac` (a `PiiHmacKeyManagerLike` that returns `hmac-sha256:hex(HMAC_SHA256(HMAC_SHA256(STUB_KEY, 'v'||keyVersion), payload))`), the `PiiHmacFilterService` MUST return EXACTLY the `expected_privacy_filtered_hashes` map. Additionally, no literal value from `inputs.pii` may appear in the serialised output (FR-014).

This vector is the canonical happy case for the HMAC-keyed filter. Conformance runners SHOULD wire a stub HMAC key manager that reproduces the algorithm and assert byte-for-byte equality on the resulting `privacy_filtered_hashes` map.

stub_hmac.derivation: derivedKey = HMAC_SHA256(stub_key_utf8, 'v' || keyVersion); tag = HMAC_SHA256(derivedKey, payload); output = 'hmac-sha256:' || hex(tag)
